sources.prompt: A fixed wide shot of a white cat walking slowly along a sunlit garden wall. Small green leaves move in a light breeze.
A locked-off medium shot of a glassblower slowly turning a glowing glass vessel in a workshop. The hands and workbench remain visible.
A fixed wide shot of blue fishing boats rocking gently beside a stone harbor wall under an overcast sky. Small ripples move across the water.
A continuous medium-wide shot of a person arranging orange flowers in a vase on a wooden table beside a bright window. The camera remains fixed.
